name: album_tools
description: Album Tools: Similar Albums, Recently Added Albums, and queue popularity bars. Uses Last.fm API and MPD library.

volumio_info.details: Similar Albums (Last.fm), Recently Added Albums (MPD), and Last.fm popularity bars for the play queue.
volumio_info.changelog: 1.3.2 Add playback_info for the artist biography, album wiki, and track wiki shown from the playback page. 1.3.1 Score the track titles reported by the library, so a song still gets a bar when Last.fm's album listing uses a different name. 1.3.0 Add Last.fm popularity bars for the play queue. A setting turns them on, and albums below a listener minimum are left unscored.
